ai_summary: This document details a disclosure by the promoter group of Ambica Agarbathies Aroma & Industries Limited, reporting an increase in their aggregate shareholding from 43.41% to 46.08%. This change occurred through a preferential allotment where four new individuals within the promoter group acquired 848,600 shares, representing 4.708% of the expanded share capital. While consolidating promoter control, this transaction inherently dilutes the percentage ownership of existing public shareholders, warranting scrutiny into the terms and pricing of the preferential allotment.
